crossRefs.note: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
“But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show…
He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as…

translations.web: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
translations.bsb: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
translations.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
translations.asv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.
